event.event_name: 2018 Northern and Central Europe heatwave-drought-wildfire-low-river-flow compound event

criteria.description: Filters the Open-Meteo daily series to 2018-05-01 through 2018-06-15.
criteria.name: Weather slice
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for using the correct product with a minor date-window or indexing error.

criteria.description: Computes Tmax exceedance above 25 C and rounds it to 35.7 C-days.
criteria.name: Heat load
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right formula with a minor summation or rounding error.

criteria.description: Computes the 9-day hot spell and 7-day warm-night run.
criteria.name: Heat persistence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if one of the two run lengths is correct.

criteria.description: Computes the 12-day dry run and 5-day hot-dry overlap run.
criteria.name: Dry persistence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if one of the two dry or overlap runs is correct.

criteria.description: Computes the local precipitation sum over the ERA5-Land regional mean and rounds to 0.657.
criteria.name: Precipitation ratio
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct sources with a denominator, sum, or rounding mistake.

criteria.description: Applies the weighted formula, rounds the score to 96.71, and returns the compact JSON fields.
criteria.name: Index formula
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly correct weighted formula or final label with one component error.
